class.name: CubismCharacterController
class.brief_description: Coordinates recorded voice and native model cues.
class.description: Uses one existing [CubismModel2D] with internal [AudioStreamPlayer] and [CubismLipSync] children. Claims the target clock during cues or idle playback, uses normal model speed and restores prior speed/process settings on release. Checkpoint state stores stable presentation choices. Use [method speak] for recorded voice with optional motion, or [method perform] for a motion cue without audio.

method.name: capture_state
method.description: Return {ok, error, state}. A successful state is a versioned JSON-compatible checkpoint containing model identity, idle/expression choices, look target, visibility, transform, tint and controller settings. Returns ERR_BUSY during a cue, visibility fade, foreign clock ownership, native callback or externally started motion. An owned idle may be captured; restore starts a fresh loop. Native handles, parameter snapshots, effect history and voice positions are not serialized.

method.name: restore_state
method.description: Restore a capture_state result's state dictionary onto an already loaded target with matching source path and import fingerprint. Validates every field and ID before changing state. Invalid data preserves current playback. A valid restore interrupts current cues, clears expression blending, restores presentation and restarts the saved idle if requested. Requires the target to be in the tree. Runtime callbacks that remove/reload a target can interrupt restoration with ERR_UNAVAILABLE. This is checkpoint restoration, not mid-voice seeking or a simulation snapshot.

method.name: return_to_idle
method.description: Stop the current cue and start idle_motion looping at IDLE priority. Returns an error for missing/invalid idle settings or unavailable target without replacing a valid cue. Returning to the same playing idle does not restart it.

method.name: is_idle
method.description: Whether the controller owns a running idle motion. Idle uses the controller clock but is not speech.

method.name: show_character
method.description: Show immediately (none) or fade from hidden to the target's original modulate alpha (fade). Preserves tint. Does not implicitly start idle playback.

method.name: hide_character
method.description: Cancel a current cue with HIDDEN, then hide immediately (none) or fade (fade). Fading voice/motion and visibility share transition_seconds. Rejects unknown transitions without changing playback.

method.name: look_at_screen_position
method.description: Convert owning-viewport coordinates through the inverse global canvas transform and supply a local look target. Includes camera/canvas transforms; coordinates are not desktop screen pixels. Rejects nonfinite or singular transforms without changing look input.

method.name: perform
method.description: Play a nonlooping motion and optional expression without starting audio. Manifest Sound metadata never starts a sound implicitly. Returns an inspectable completion handle.

method.name: speak
method.description: Coordinate an explicit finite prerecorded stream with optional motion and expression. A nonnull profile enables envelope lip sync; null leaves authored animation alone. Normal speed, nonlooping streams only. Both audio and motion must finish for natural completion.

method.name: stop_speaking
method.description: Stop the current cue. Finite fade in [0,60] controls voice volume and outgoing motion; zero stops immediately. Completion status changes immediately. Pausing freezes an outgoing fade.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advance a manually processed controller by finite seconds in [0,60]. Audio-clock mode still uses the selected audio authority. SDK steps are bounded to 0.1 seconds.

method.name: submit_audio_clock
method.description: Supply a deterministic audio timestamp in manual_audio_clock mode. Time must be within the stream duration. No audio is started in this simulation mode. A backward jump greater than 0.05 seconds fails the cue on its next update; smaller jitter is clamped. General seeking is unsupported.

method.name: get_audio_position
method.description: Last monotonic audible-time estimate or submitted manual clock. Real audio extrapolates at most one mixer interval. Across mixed timestamp reads it uses the observed playback position minus latency without interpolation, retaining the previous estimate if that position is older. Stable samples allow backward jitter of the greater of 0.05 seconds or one mixer interval plus 0.005 seconds; larger discontinuities fail the cue. Manual audio retains a fixed 0.05-second allowance.

method.name: get_model_time
method.description: Model seconds evaluated by this cue, including negative-offset pre-roll.

method.name: get_sync_error
method.description: Evaluated model time minus audible estimate and pre-roll during voice playback. This is clock alignment, not measured hardware latency.

method.name: get_motion_handle
method.description: Current or most recently started cue/idle motion handle; null for voice-only cues or before a positive offset starts the motion.

method.name: is_speaking
method.description: Whether a nonterminal cue is active, including perform without voice.

method.name: set_cue_offset_seconds
method.description: Set [member cue_offset_seconds]. Returns ERR_BUSY while a cue is retained, ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER for a nonfinite value or a value outside [-60,60], and OK on success. Rejection preserves the previous offset.

method.name: set_manual_audio_clock
method.description: Set [member manual_audio_clock]. Returns ERR_BUSY while a cue is retained; otherwise returns OK.

method.name: set_manual_process
method.description: Set [member manual_process]. Returns ERR_BUSY while a cue is retained; otherwise returns OK.

method.name: set_target_model
method.description: Assign [member target_model], cancelling a transition and interrupting the current cue when the target changes. Returns ERR_BUSY during a controller operation; otherwise returns OK. Clock ownership is checked when playback starts.

method.name: set_transition_seconds
method.description: Set [member transition_seconds]. Returns an error when the controller is busy, a transition is active, or the value is nonfinite or outside [0,60]. Rejection preserves the previous duration.

method.name: set_voice_bus
method.description: Set [member voice_bus]. Returns ERR_BUSY while a cue is retained; otherwise returns OK. Bus availability is checked when starting voice playback.

signal.name: runtime_warning
signal.description: Deferred diagnostic when automatic idle resumption fails.

members.member: Motion ID used by return_to_idle and optional automatic resumption. Empty has no implicit fallback.
Resume idle after normal cue completion. Stop, interruption, hiding and errors do not automatically restart idle.
Fade duration in [0,60], set when no transition is running. Zero makes fade immediate. Pausing freezes fades; retargeting or controller disposal cancels them and restores original opacity.
Target node. Reassigning interrupts a current cue. A second controller cannot claim an already owned clock.
Existing output bus; use a separate bus per character for envelope isolation. Default Master. Set while idle.
Use advance instead of automatic idle processing. Set while idle.
Simulation/test mode: use submitted absolute audio positions, without starting audio or sampling a bus. Set while idle.
Pause audio and model cue evaluation. Target model pause also freezes the cue. Keep submitting the same timestamp while a manual clock is paused.
Finite voiced-motion offset in [-60,60]. Positive delays motion; negative pre-rolls motion before audio. No-audio perform ignores this setting. Set while idle.
